description: Saudi electrical-energy statistics report licensed generation capacity, peak demand, energy delivered to the grid and consumption by region and customer category. GASTAT publishes the methodology and quality description for the 2024 series. The provider is General Authority for Statistics. Coverage: Coverage is Saudi Arabia’s electricity sector, with annual indicators and administrative-region breakdowns. The methodology page identifies 2024 and a November 2025 update. Access: The official methodology page was read. Published tables and statistical files were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Method definitions are verified; numerical completeness and exact data-file availability are not. Capacity, delivered energy and sold energy must not be interchanged. For simulation it supplies national capacity and demand calibration definitions and links to statistical outputs. Related resources: DataSaudi is an indicator distributor; this is the original agency’s electricity-statistics series.
